first_off_proof.qualification: Saved first physical OFF and accounting only; current identity/physical/transport gates remain mandatory in the kernel.

bounds: Only closed files reviewed; no live kernel, GPU or sysfs interfaces touched.
Snapshots are sequential and non-atomic; unchanged memory is not a writer or DMA retirement proof.
E2 own202 intention and subsequent ACK bind the source write route; no independent TX acceptance readback or correlated request ID was added.
CPU clear10/20 fresh readbacks are required by exact pinned source and success route; E2 compact rows retain finalcontrol0 rather than a separate numeric readback for each write.
STATUS0 coordination is the native bypass branch, not a PMP ACK or wholeGPU inactivity proof.
ColdAP20 is an owned exact cold request/reply mirror retained across management202; skip is not a fresh AP reply.
First epoch OFF/host-stop flags are historical; current secondOFF is independently established by own second chain and fresh PMGR/accounting.
Later compactCTRL/STATUS/RX/TX are cached preceding operands; laterdiagnostic intentionally skipsASC.
Both once controls are consumed, all174pages/root/context/maps/consumer/MMIO/claims/module remain retained; no extra cycle/work/free/unload is admitted.
A successful bounded retained management cycle does not establish arbitrary fault recovery, app/UAT/context rejoin, repeatability across freshboots or pixels.
